lead_story: The Fed rates decision is the biggest macro driver right now, with oil prices and Middle East tensions also playing a role. The Fed's decision will likely influence the direction of the dollar and stocks. A pause in the West Asia crisis is also curbing inflation risk and supporting gold prices.
